title: Silver Account: Transferring funds to external banks
summary: This document explains how Silver Account external bank transfers are processed, including standard completion in ~2 business days after submission (timing varies by submission time and the receiving bank). It sets a $5,000/day cap on total outgoing external transfers and notes potential partial processing/declines for amounts above the limit, plus $0.00 monthly fee for paper statements (enabled in settings) and tips for accurate details and monitoring confirmations/notifications.
faqs: How long do Silver Account transfers to external banks take to complete?
What is the daily limit for outgoing external transfers from my Silver Account ($5,000/day)?
What happens if I submit an external transfer request for more than the $5,000/day limit?
Is there a monthly fee for paper statements related to transfer verification or recordkeeping?
How can I reduce delays when transferring to an external bank?
How will I know my external transfer status (in-app confirmations and email notifications)?
